turns.user_message: We're working on the Harborview Sailing Club dock replacement and I need to nail down the structural load specification. What's the maximum live load per square foot the new dock must support?
turns.assistant_message: According to the Dock Replacement Project Charter v2.1, the new dock structure must support a minimum live load of 75 pounds per square foot to accommodate simultaneous foot traffic, equipment staging, and vessel mooring loads. turns.assistant_message: The Dock Replacement Project Charter v2.1 specifies that all deck surfaces must use pressure-treated Douglas fir planking, 2 inches thick by 6 inches wide, with a maximum gap of 3/8 inch between boards.
